question: How does difference-form arrangement arise in the enjoyer-self?
premises: In the enjoyer-self this difference-form arrangement exists.
It resorts to cooperation in own work production.
inference: Difference-form arrangement in the enjoyer-self arises through cooperation in producing one's own work.
plain_english: In the enjoyer-self, this difference-form arrangement exists; thus it resorts to cooperation in the production of its own work.
